6064628973614399489.title: Apprentice Miner's Skivvies
6064628973614399489.description: The inner band is inscribed with a miner's mantra in faded ink: "Beneath the earth, truth." Few notice it. Few who do, ever forget it.

6064629347405269238.title: Longbow of Briarhome
6064629347405269238.description: A relic of formidable craftsmanship, carved from elderwood and steeped in the druidic rites of the Briarhome wilds. It draws not just arrows--but the will of the forest itself.

6064629386955915289.description: This is a massive history book of every major event in Verran history since the dawn of life.

6064629449226715146.description: The dagger is crafted of a black metal. It has the title "Goblin Slayer" on one side of the blade and "Bronson" on the opposite.

6064629721957400576.title: Ashes of the Forgotten

6064629722036895747.title: Ashes of Lochspire
6064629722036895747.description: This pouch of ashes was hidden on an island mausoleum.

6064629937306665072.title: a gelatinous eye
6064629937306665072.description: an false eyeball formed from a mysterious spongy material.

6064630010912112640.title: Eagle Gryphon
6064630010912112640.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Cloaked in wind and crowned in sunlight, the Eagle Gryphon reigns over the skies with a presence both regal and unrelenting. Its wings span like the banners of forgotten empires, each feather sharp with purpose and etched with the memory of high places. The lion's strength coils beneath its taloned grace, and its cry carries like a trumpet over stone and treetop. Forged in the thin air of ancient mountain thrones, the Eagle Gryphon is a creature of clarity and command, drawn to those who rule not with secrecy but with vision cast wide and true. It serves the Mayor of Winstead alone, recognizing in them the soul of a leader who does not follow the path but charts it.

6064630101660139673.title: Basic Wheels
6064630101660139673.description: A customized wheel for your caravan.

6064630140318842982.title: Novice Fishing Pole
6064630140318842982.description: Sanded smooth and strung tight, this pole flexes like a promise. You'll remember every cast.

6064630140419702898.title: Novice Herbalist's Shirt
6064630140419702898.description: The pockets are too shallow, the fabric too thin--but somehow, as it takes pride in every new grass stain, it simply works.

6064630140434251891.title: Novice Lumberjack's Shirt
6064630140434251891.description: Stitched from oxcloth and dyed in crushed alder bark, this shirt carries the scent of green wood and wet earth. Its sleeves roll high, and its cuffs fray early--both signs that it's being used correctly.

6064630140435693684.title: Apprentice Lumberjack's Pants
6064630140435693684.description: Stiff-legged trousers waxed with pine sap to repel water, insects, and weak resolve. They smell of timber and toil, and they only soften after your first season of honest work.

6064630140452929656.title: Apprentice Hunter's Leggings
6064630140452929656.description: Woven from wind-swept flax and padded with down, these undergarments barely rustle, even in motion. The forest will forget you're there--until it's too late.

6064630141131554963.title: Apprentice Jeweler's Skivvies
6064630141131554963.description: They say a true jeweler must be comfortable enough to sit still for hours--and this cloth never itches, no matter how long the focus.

6064630141158031519.title: Journeyman Animal Husbandrist's Tool Belt
6064630141158031519.description: Tooled with the sigil of Sifora, Patroness of Animal Husbandry, this water-resistant leather belt carries the calm of her touch. Each loop and pouch seems to know what tool it holds, and when you need it most, it's always within reach.

6064630141162029217.title: Novice Metalworker's Shirt
6064630141162029217.description: The back panel is looser than the front, not for comfort, but for the arch of a hammer swing. If it doesn't pull when you strike, you're doing it wrong.

6064630141183328427.title: Novice Weaver's Shirt
6064630141183328427.description: Novice weavers will stain it with dye and fray it on spindle edges--but their first tunic will accept each mark with alacrity, as another step in their journey to ultimate mastery of the craft.

6064630174224089205.title: Helm of the Horns
6064630174224089205.description: An ancient helm crafted for the hornless members of the infamous Horns of the Bull, marauders led by a minotaur hero.

6064630174244995190.title: Skull of Brayox
6064630174244995190.description: Ancient and brittle minotaur skull. It bears the mark of the minotaur champion, Vultauro the Bull.

6064630407096893444.title: Quickroot Trousers
6064630407096893444.description: Threaded with charmed twine--every herb knows you're coming, but none will be fast enough to escape your grasp!

6064630678666674860.title: Shards of the Star Ward
6064630678666674860.description: This is all that is left of a shattered crystal.

6064630705872568322.description:
Process: Alchemy

6064630990418673680.title: a Vanguard Gem
6064630990418673680.description: A gem that once placed onto a memorial.

6064631000780242948.title: A Wind Flute
6064631000780242948.description: This odd musical instrument is a cross between a wind chime and flute. It seems to be only part of a whole.

6064631007364907040.title: Lost Scroll
6064631007364907040.description: The thick parchment has taken great damage from the elements. Whoever lost this was using it to map their way to a hidden dig site.

6064631007412551714.title: Bone of an Ancient Giant
6064631007412551714.description: This is a large fragment of a much larger skull, a giant's skull! It looks to predate the age of Aelans.

6064631113746284548.title: Stillsoul
6064631113746284548.description: Modeled after a forged blade said to be quenched in the heart-ice of an ancient frost giant, Stillsoul pulses with a quiet hunger for warmth-- and the power to end it.

6064631121016127508.title: Terror Bird
more: This towering avian brute cuts an unmistakable figure with its thick feathered coat, blunt wings, and massive clawed feet built for sprinting. Its hooked beak and sharp eyes give it a predatory air, even when still. Though it lacks flight, its speed and ferocity more than make up for it. Outfitted with woven leather reins and saddle, this beast now serves as a battle-hardened mount for those who prize raw power and primal fear.

6064631121024843799.title: Maelstrom's Crown
6064631121024843799.description:
Ground Mount
Level 30

150% Ground Speed
150% Water Speed

6064631125008580609.title: TO: Candor's Kettle, Riverlands
6064631125008580609.description: This is large package of artisan resources. It bears the mark of the Greyshore Transporters.

6064631131847720960.title: Rusty Dagger
6064631131847720960.description: The blade flakes when touched, and yet, a soft hum of arcane potential seeps from every corroded edge. It shouldn't work--but magic doesn't care what should.

6064631171214671894.title: Acadira Valarion Pauldrons
6064631171214671894.description: Pauldrons like these endure the yoke of duty, first as protection against petty threats, then against agents of the apocalypse.

6064631188680015919.description: Property of the Greyshore Transport Company, Riverlands Post. Deliver to: The Carphin Expeditionary Camp. Deposit on Freight Deliveries.

6064631199666536503.title: Terrorgore Hide Leggings
6064631199666536503.description: Animal hide laced with the bones of vanquished warriors, beasts, and undying abominations. They bear the faint scent of pine tar and copper, which intensifies near forgotten cairns.

6064631200035373138.title: Recipe: Bough Warden's Recurve
6064631200035373138.description: Apprentice Carpentry recipe for creating a Bough Warden's Recurve

6064631200480493677.description: Apprentice Armorsmithing recipe for creating Arbor Etched Tassets.

6064631204599431170.title: Bonewoven Headdress
6064631204599431170.description: Despite its ghastly and unsettling appearance, it exudes power, as if the bones themselves remember something that could prove useful.

6064631205526438102.description:
Drop: The Kingfish 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: A fragment of a shining blade, marked with a fishlike scale pattern.

6064631205526569175.title: Chain of Command
6064631205526569175.description:
Drop: The Kingfish 
Ingredient In: Jeweler
more: A hefty steel chain, liberated from a bandit lord.

6064631206459802089.title: Silken Slippers of the Scholar
6064631206459802089.description: Favored by scribes and academics who move through libraries and scriptoria like passing thoughts--felt more than heard.

6064631211347673751.title: Fire-Scarred Chestplate
6064631211347673751.description: Flames may mar its perfection, but the mark of its maker will still shine through ruin.

6064631228654551124.title: Recipe: Gravedusted Greaves
6064631228654551124.description: Journeyman Armorsmithing recipe for creating Gravedusted Greaves.

6064631233755545604.title: Profaned Blade
6064631233755545604.description: Something has filmed the bright steel of this blade with a strange oily finish that will not wash away.

6064631233812693012.title: Papercut
6064631233812693012.description: A deceptively innocuous blade with an ironic name and a taste for precision. It's light, silent, and sharper than it has any right to be--especially when aimed at the heart.

6064631233846771740.title: Monitor Blade
6064631233846771740.description: A disciplined weapon issued to those entrusted with command, scrutiny, and enforcement. It isn't ornate or boastful--it's a blade that observes before it acts--and never asks twice.

6064631234493022738.title: Gloves of the Undying Scholar
6064631234493022738.description: Ink-stained and grave-dirt grimy--they stiffen when spells fly, or when someone uses the word "irregardless."

6064631234500952645.title: Gravy Stained Apron
6064631234500952645.description: A culinary relic with a questionable history, undeniable charm, and the aroma of something very-nearly edible.

6064631234583069365.title: Enchanted Metal Plate
6064631234583069365.description:
Drop: The Enchanted Cuirass 
Ingredient In: Armorsmithing
more: An enchanted piece of metal designed for protection.

6064631234584773311.title: Monitor's Leather Scraps
6064631234584773311.description:
Drop: The Monitor 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: Leather scraps ripped from a great armored knight.

6064631240113324071.title: Invoker's Gem
6064631240113324071.description:
Drop: The Tormented Invoker  
Ingredient In: Jeweler
more: A powerful gem soaked in dark energy.

6064631250282020874.description: Journeyman Weaponsmithing recipe for Knapped Razor

6064631250911035424.description: Journeyman Leatherworking recipe for Ocular Skin Handbag.

6064631272567341059.title: Court of Cloaks Coin
6064631272567341059.description: The coin has lost its luster. It's made of cheap copper and is not valuable. There is a fading image of a Cloak on one side and the image of a Gavel on the opposite side.

6064631312296968201.title: Stone Cyclops Eye
6064631312296968201.description: A small stone crafted to appear like a miniature representation of a cyclops eye. It peer to the right.

sources.name: The gravestone has no name. A large cyclops face is carved into it. The eye peers to the right and seems to be loose.

6064631363391193157.title: Tower Guard Payroll
6064631363391193157.description: A strongbox filled with coins. It has the emblem of the Tower Division of the Kaelar Army.

6064631521224622096.title: Head of Karnoor
6064631521224622096.description: The severed head of Karnoor the Wolf Whisperer.

6064631629189349381.title: Stone of Tura'Madu
6064631629189349381.description: This smooth stone has a crest of Tura'Madu on it. Within the crest you can barely make out the eroding name, 'Ludic.'

6064631663503540229.title: Journeyman Enchanting Charm
6064631663503540229.description: Improves the chance to enchant gear

6064631703329898806.title: Splint's Pouch
6064631703329898806.description: A pouch of powder. It seems much heavier than it should. It must be a special form of powder or sand. It bears the name of the burglar, Splint.

sources.name: A collection useless items seized from Highwaymen recruits. Useless junk!

6064631703334748212.title: Piece of Broken Kaelar Badge
6064631703334748212.description: A newly issued badge of Kaelar allegiance. It appears to have been snapped into a few pieces. Perhaps a goblin wanted to use it as a toothpick.

6064631714157232129.title: Novice Potent Enchanting Scroll
6064631714157232129.description: Required to enchant gear, if enchanting is successful, gain additional enchanting level. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631714170994695.title: Novice Fortuitous Enchanting Scroll
6064631714170994695.description: Required to enchant gear, multiplies success chance by 100%. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631721684434953.title: Journeyman Potent Enchanting Scroll
6064631721684434953.description: Required to enchant gear, if enchanting is successful, gain additional enchanting level. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631721685942289.title: Journeyman Favored Enchanting Scroll
6064631721685942289.description: Required to enchant gear, multiplies success chance by 10%. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631746144239636.title: Salvaged Medical Supplies
6064631746144239636.description: An assortment of bandages, poultices and potions packed neatly into a soft kit.

6064631827293077506.title: Goblin's Bone Dangles
6064631827293077506.description: Slaznug is as enchanted by the fetid stench of these fire-blackened rat skulls, as he is by their gruesome appearance.

6064631827856687105.description: Apprentice Jeweler recipe for Goblin's Bone Dangles.

6064631861940518921.title: Forsaken Blade
6064631861940518921.description: Found buried upright in a cairn of jawless skulls, it shimmered when touched. Some say it still knows the weight of every head it has taken.

6064631867812282369.title: Trechery's Vessel
6064631867812282369.description: A forbidden focus pulsing with the arcane residue of betrayal. It's not just a magical conduit--it's a reminder that power, once broken, never forgets.

6064631868569550856.title: Sephillion Shard Necklace
6064631868569550856.description: Eldritch phantoms stir within this crystal fragment, restless beneath the weight of iron's unyielding grip.

6064631913790767511.title: Apprentice Hunting Bow
6064631913790767511.description: Carved from duskwood and lacquered with bloodsap, it darkens with each beast brought low. Legend has it this bow fires truer under moonlight.

6064631913801253351.title: Crude Hunting Bow
6064631913801253351.description:
Unmarked and unbalanced, this bow has claimed more fingers than quarry. It's more suggestion than weapon--but sometimes, that's enough.

You can only switch tools while inside a Node.

sources.name: I need to deliver the Shoddy Granite Ashlar Blocks to a Tradesmanager.

We'll provide ye with a whole set o' tools--nae quality--but functional tools. In return, I'll have ye harvest a Wilted Snowdrop plant, bring 'em back here, an' process them ta Stale Snowdrop Powder at the Alchemy Station. We need it fer healin' salves what with all th' goblin attacks.

We'll provide ye with a whole set o' tools--nae quality--but functional tools. In return, I'll have ye harvest snowdrop plants, bring 'em back here, an' process them ta powder at the herbalism station. We need it fer healin' salves what with all th' goblin attacks.

6064631924575502919.title: Strange Flower Petal
6064631924575502919.description: The flower petal is waxen and brittle. Its edges look like wrinkled velvet and it tastes somewhat metallic.

6064631942165168171.title: Brew Bear Cub
6064631942165168171.description: Requires Apprentice Animal Husbandry to breed.

6064631942229786680.title: Plumed Haleberder Chick

6064632055326441482.title: Letter of Introduction
6064632055326441482.description: A letterr, sealed with a wax impression depicting a cloak and dagger. It's addressed to you.

sources.name: A man named Hatham asked me to deliver the medical supplies to a woman near a shrine on the North side of Lionhold.
Bring this letter of introduction under the temple in the ruined water gardens to the North East. Find the ones beneath the winged statue.

6064632072411283493.title: Implacable Boots
6064632072411283493.description: Tread without hesitation, even where the ground remembers blood. They've marched through ash so fine it whispered like snow.

6064632077070368777.description: Move with the body in stillness or in flight, their cut as unrestrictive as the open meadow.

6064632082899534018.title: Emberlight Belt
6064632082899534018.description: Binds tight with a single pull, and never shifts unless commanded. A small hidden clasp, forged in volcanic glass, bears the mark of an extinct forge cult.

6064632121097912321.description: These greaves advance, slow and steady, with the certainty of something that has never known defeat.

6064632121108398087.description: A final layer of defense, unwavering as the warrior who wears them. This armor bows to nothing.

6064632140538707970.title: Glolrybound Frostbound Great Grimoire
6064632140538707970.description: Paper runs crisp beneath the hand, a clean chill lingering in the gutter as if kept close to marble.

6064632140544999430.title: Brooksteel Grimoire
6064632140544999430.description: Inscribed with glyphs drawn in tide-washed ink, the Brooksteel Grimoire hums when opened near flowing water. Pages turn of their own accord in moonlight, and spells written within never seem to fade, only blur when misread.

6064632780421070849.title: Siege Banner Pole

6064632990046552064.description: With a wave of her mighty scepter, Farajah restored the Djinnbound Essence Cradle from malfunction. "A bit of maintenance is all it takes" - Farajah the Djinnmagi circa 3450 3E

6064632990845960202.title: Dustbound Earring
6064632990845960202.description: Dry to the touch even in stormlight, this earring stirs faintly when crossing old ground. Some say it holds the shape of roads that no longer exist.

6064633050324336645.title: Scorpion Broodling
6064633050324336645.description:
Ground Mount
Level 9

165% Ground Speed
50% Maximum Health
more: Though smaller and younger than its full-grown kin, the Scorpion Broodling is no less fierce. These adolescent arachnids are agile and temperamental, making them ideal mounts for scouts, skirmishers, and those who favor speed over size. Their claws are still strong enough to snap bone, and their barbed tails carry a potent sting. With careful training, they can become loyal and lightning-quick companions, darting through narrow passes and over harsh sands where larger mounts might falter.

6064633067295014920.description: Journeyman Armorsmithing recipe for creating Cataphract Of Valor Faulds.

A Guild Master may consume this scroll to declare war on another Guild.

Defector and Rebel camps will be unconvered. Destroy the Defectors and protect the Rebels to gain victory points.

The first guild to reach 500 victory points win.

6064633271738892372.title: Glorybound Twin Daggers
6064633271738892372.description: Cool bright steel and clean shoulders, edges crisp as frost traced on morning stone.

6064633288742207489.title: Sun-warmed Iron Rod
6064633288742207489.description:
Drop: Wartrainer Rhogan 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: A sun-warmed iron rod, worn at the ends and kissed with rust. Its once smooth surface is now pitted and worn. It still holds the day's heat.

6064633288742404098.title: Bedraggled Paw
6064633288742404098.description:
Drop: Miserable Dustpaw 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: This dessicated bear paw is much larger than normal. It's cracked, leathery skin is stretched taut over brittle pads, sparse fur, and worn, sun-faded claws. Dull bone protrudes where the tough muscle has been pulled away.

6064633288742862854.title: Polychrome Links
6064633288742862854.description:
Drop: Dom Champion of Gom 
Ingredient In: Jeweler
more: These polychrome links are a chain of five unique links, each from a different alloy, symbolizing the unity of the Exalted races. In ancient Verra, these were worn by representatives of the Council of Zaran.

6064633289002450955.title: Blackened Steel Buckle
6064633289002450955.description:
Drop: The Shackled 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: A blackened steel buckle, bent and worn. Rust eats at its edges, the metal dull and scarred. An old dent mars its face, evidence of a heavy boot or rough treatment. The dim imprint of a skull and crossbones decorates the front.

6064633289003237394.title: Brass Thimble
6064633289003237394.description:
Drop: Cognocker Eddis 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: A small, brass cap, slightly domed, with a textured surface for grip. It looks like it should protect the end of a thumb on a work glove. The glove is absent, though.

6064633289004679190.title: Fire-Beetle Eye
6064633289004679190.description:
Drop: Molten Queen 
Ingredient In: Jeweler
more: A faceted orb, swirling with molten gold and crimson. Tiny embers flicker within, casting dancing shadows.

6064633289530146853.title: Forsaken Sabre
6064633289530146853.description: The officers of the Forsaken Blades often carried weapons intended for the mission. The Forsaken Sabre was best used in long journeys where weight is best kept light and attacks must be swift.

6064633289670525096.title: Bloodletter's Cloak
6064633289670525096.description: As luck would have it, Flombard had used his last remaining strength to transform. Were he not enfeebled by his fasting, he could have freed himself from the Sladeborne's bindings and struck him down with one swift motion of the Bloodletter's Cloak. Instead, he became one of Kesetal's gruesome specimens.

6064633289703489769.title: Deepwater Cuirass
6064633289703489769.description: The ancient Deepwater Brig guards were often equipped with intricate chainmail that allowed for swift movements, yet repelled most prisoner's makeshift weapons.

6064633289746153800.title: Malgorach's Heart
6064633289746153800.description: Torn from Malgorach's living pyresteel body, this chestplate radiates the volatile magic that summoned the creature. Its jagged surface crackles with molten remnants, a testament to the fury it once embodied.

6064633605997854726.title: Wyrmling
6064633605997854726.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Vinebreach holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

6064633860908646443.title: Hallowmark Sash
6064633860908646443.description: Tightens before speaking sacred names, then releases slowly afterward.

6064633860909367344.title: Suncleft Choir Leggings
6064633860909367344.description: Balanced for the long ascents of mountain processions, these leggings carry a memory of cadence, measured, sonorous, and unshaken by stone or time.

6064633860909367346.title: Suncleft Choir Spaulders
6064633860909367346.description: Each curve is tuned like a bell, shaped to catch echoes from the vaults of the Duunhold and carry them down into silence.

6064633860910350390.title: Starlight Creed Cape
6064633860910350390.description: Threaded in hidden coves beneath moonlit spray, this cape holds the hush of open water and the distant shimmer of unseen stars. It moves with a rhythm tuned to tides not charted on any map.

6064633860910350392.title: Starlight Creed Boots
6064633860910350392.description: Salt-touched and tide-worn, these boots carry the rhythm of sandbars and shifting stars. Each step feels drawn by currents unseen, steady beneath moonlight and mist.

6064633860910743622.title: Scorchwander Belt
6064633860910743622.description: This belt bears the weave of long-lost paths through windblown canyons, each knot a memory of crossings made under a sun that never relents. It rests easily, as if it has already walked the desert once before.

6064633860915921040.title: Cindermarch Cape
6064633860915921040.description: Hangs in deep, fire-warmed folds, its edges catching the faint glow of embers as if it had just passed through the forge hall.

6064633860915921042.title: Cindermarch Boots
6064633860915921042.description: Step firm on gravel and scree, the tread gripping each rise with the confidence of one born to the mountain paths.

6064633860916773034.title: Gritmantle Helm
6064633860916773034.description: Shadows the eyes beneath a steady brow, the gaze beneath unbroken by the glare of sun on pale stone.

6064633860918411455.title: Slagwalker Boots
6064633860918411455.description: Broad-soled for grip on slick stone, each tread patterned to shed grit and molten flecks alike.

6064633860918411457.title: Slagwalker Bracers
6064633860918411457.description: Forged with ridged reinforcement where the heat of the forge bites deepest, the metal etched by years of hammerfall.

6064633860918739149.title: Wavebound Belt
6064633860918739149.description: A cinch of strong cord and reinforced clasp, holding the whole in place against the shove of wind and the heave of the sea.

6064633860919066838.title: Dunecoil Belt
6064633860919066838.description: Holds the set snug and ready, its straps and ties laid so nothing shifts in the press of travel or combat.

6064633860919525598.title: Gloomraider Gloves
6064633860919525598.description: Close with the precision of a hunter's grip, steady whether climbing a wall of vines or drawing steel in close quarters.

6064633860920312035.title: Wildmarch Boots
6064633860920312035.description: Broad-soled for uneven ground, they carry the weight of the traveler over root, shale, and sodden earth alike.

6064633860921229566.title: Scorchmantle Boots
6064633860921229566.description: Their soles are shaped to grip both dune and stone, each step leaving only a faint impression before the wind claims it.

6064633860921491720.title: Duskhunter Leggings
6064633860921491720.description: Move freely through the crouch of a stalk or the lunge of pursuit, their cut avoiding snags while keeping the pace swift.

6064633860971561308.title: Stormcanon Greaves
6064633860971561308.description: Balanced to the tilt of swaying decks and the pull of undertows, these greaves steady the stride through sudden impact. Their motion recalls the lull between swells, where the world forgets to breathe.

6064633860971823455.title: Sunwrought Backplate
6064633860971823455.description: Etched with patterns said to mirror the wind-scoured glyphs of the Zaranan Wastes, this backplate carries the weight of oaths buried beneath the dunes. It warms in daylight, not with heat, but with memory.

6064633860971823462.title: Sunwrought Gardbracers
6064633860971823462.description: Shaped in reverence to forgotten deities of the deep desert, these gardbracers seem to shimmer with heat even in darkness, as if warmed by an unseen sun.

6064633860983685546.title: Brineplate Bracers
6064633860983685546.description: Secure the arms with the pull of the undertow, their grip lending the same surety and force as the sea that draws all things into its power.

6064633860985061830.title: Ironwake Gauntlets
6064633860985061830.description: Close with the certainty of forged links, the hands made strong for grip, lift, and lasting hold.

6064633860985061832.title: Ironwake Greaves
6064633860985061832.description: Stand with the patience of quarry stone before the mason's cut, each step carrying the grounded resolve of the high peaks.

6064633860986372573.title: Cryptward Cape
6064633860986372573.description: It moves like a shadow that has slipped free of its master, trailing the weight of sealed doors and the cold breath of halls where no light has walked for centuries.

6064633860986372578.title: Cryptward Helm
6064633860986372578.description: Its visor admits only the world that matters, shutting out the whispers from the dark so the bearer sees nothing but the threat to be struck down.

6064633860987486704.title: Anvilguard Breastplate
6064633860987486704.description: Within its shaping lies the discipline of countless forges, each strike of the hammer folding resolve into the heart it protects.

6064633860987486710.title: Anvilguard Pauldrons
6064633860987486710.description: Resting on the shoulders like the weight of command, they bear the shape of battlements against the sky.

6064633860988666369.title: Sandbastion Cloak
6064633860988666369.description: It sweeps with the long reach of the desert wind, its folds carrying the dry scent of stone ramparts that have stood through centuries of sun and storm.

6064633860989321742.title: Tombplate Gauntlets
6064633860989321742.description: Close around the hands with a guardian's hold, prepared to seal what must be kept and to crush what must not pass.

6064633860997710363.title: Emberwake Hood
6064633860997710363.description: Said to warm as breath shortens, as though remembering prayers once spoken beneath the mountain.

6064633860998300190.title: Thistlemaw Mantle
6064633860998300190.description: Holds a scent that draws insects near but sends birds away.

6064633860999479863.title: Candlefen Sash
6064633860999479863.description: Tightens on its own when the forgotten name is spoken aloud.

6064633861004132930.title: Ward of the Sevenfold Light Spaulders
6064633861004132930.description: Cut along ancient lines drawn by the artisans of Kal Torhum, these spaulders were fitted not for battle alone, but for witness. Their surface bends light strangely, as if remembering the seven truths once spoken in the heartforge.

6064633861004132932.title: Ward of the Sevenfold Light Hauberk
6064633861004132932.description: Ritual-bound and soot-darkened, this hauberk bears the sigils of a forgotten vigil. Its weight speaks not of burden, but of purpose, as though forged to carry the weight of oaths sealed beneath mountain shadow.

6064633861012062908.title: Thistledown Gloves
6064633861012062908.description: Grip with a sure but unforced touch, as ready to gather herbs as to draw an arrow to the cheek.

6064633861012259521.title: Glimmersoot Sash
6064633861012259521.description: Knots at the hip with the easy grip of a smith's tie, keeping every layer settled no matter the pace or the climb.

6064633861012718293.title: Veilsand Boots
6064633861012718293.description: Tread softly on shifting ground, their soles shaping to the sand so the wearer leaves little behind but a fading trace.

6064633861012980447.title: Wraithskin Bracers
6064633861012980447.description: Lie flat against the forearms, lending a guarded strength while keeping every movement swift and quiet.

6064633861013832421.title: Brightgrove Sash
6064633861013832421.description: Binds the layers together in a silent knot, its ties resting still against the hip no matter the pace.

6064633861014291194.title: Seawisp Bracers
6064633861014291194.description: Rest light on the forearms, turning aside the errant strike while keeping the hands swift and sure.

6064633861014553342.title: Duneflare Leggings
6064633861014553342.description: Move with the body in long, loping strides, the fabric loose enough for air to flow while keeping the heat at bay.

6064633861014881033.title: Nightwhisper Sash
6064633861014881033.description: Knots with practiced ease, its ties resting flat against the hip so nothing shifts or rattles when the wearer moves.

6064633861014881038.title: Nightwhisper Cloak
6064633861014881038.description: Falls in folds as dark as the understory at midnight, its edges dissolving into the gloom until the eye can no longer follow their line.

6064633866783948860.title: Foamcast Earring
6064633866783948860.description: Cast in a shape that captures a wave's first curl, it holds a pearly gleam that brightens near open water. A hush like far surf lives in it, barely heard, always present.

6064633866784079934.title: Foamcast Ring
6064633866784079934.description: A crescent ridge rises along the rim in the moment before a wave breaks, pearl bright and calm as a glassy tide.

6064633867063328873.title: Mirageborn Axe
6064633867063328873.description: Contours ripple like wind-drawn dunes, the profile seeming to shift just before the strike lands true.

6064633867064246380.title: Deepweld Axe
6064633867064246380.description: Forged where the mountain breathes warm, its edge holds the calm weight of stone halls and the hush after the last hammerfall.

6064633867083645052.title: Sandcarved Great Axe
6064633867083645052.description: Etched with the scouring memory of desert winds, this axe holds the silence between sunfall and storm. Its edge recalls shapes buried by time.

6064633867101012119.title: Mistwood Tome of Spells
6064633867101012119.description: Soft to the touch and always faintly damp, the Mistwood Tome of Spells never gathers dust. When opened beneath trees, nearby leaves often rustle without wind.

6064633867110056091.title: Sandcarved Codex
6064633867110056091.description: Etched with wind-scored sigils, this volume gathers the weight of time in its creases. It reads more clearly when dust coats the hands.

6064633867126571201.title: Wavecutter Twin Daggers
6064633867126571201.description: Long curves carry the shape of cleaving wakes through open water.

6064633867177165012.title: Flameheart Focus
6064633867177165012.description: A steady warmth lies in its hue, as if the forge's breath lingers within.

6064633867225989433.title: Runeweld Rapier
6064633867225989433.description: The Runeweld Rapier feels impossibly balanced, as if guided by lines unseen. Symbols near the guard grow faint when lies are told nearby.

6064633867236082007.title: Ironhearth Scepter
6064633867236082007.description: Forged thick and plain, the Ironhearth Scepter steadies the hand that holds it. When struck against stone, it sends a clear note through the ground, felt more than heard.

6064633867236606297.title: Stoneforge Scepter
6064633867236606297.description: Hewn from a single core and cool as untouched ore, the Stoneforge Scepter carries the weight of quiet judgment. When tapped three times, it settles the dust in the air around it.

6064633867239489884.title: Sandcarved Scepter
6064633867239489884.description: Etched by wind and memory, this scepter hums with the hush of shifting dunes. Beneath its silence coils the resolve of something buried too long.

6064633867243880813.title: Glassveil Scepter
6064633867243880813.description: Translucent planes catch and release light like calm glass beneath a desert noon.

6064633867286020580.title: Deepwake Sword
6064633867286020580.description: Its weight carries the gravity of the mountain's heart. Dark seams run the length of the blade like veins of shadowed ore.

6064633867287003624.title: Wavecutter Greatsword
6064633867287003624.description: Its edge glides as though the air itself were water, parting in perfect silence. The steel bears the faint scent of deep tides and distant horizons.

6064633867287986668.title: Mirageborn Greatsword
6064633867287986668.description: It blurs at the edges as though refusing to be seen clearly. The air around it bends, distorting truth.

6064633867288904176.title: Glassveil Greatsword
6064633867288904176.description: Its surface is flawless and cold, revealing nothing to those who gaze upon it. The edge is thin enough to part light itself.

6064633867290411507.title: Mistwood Wand
6064633867290411507.description: Slender as a reed and always slightly damp, the Mistwood Wand feels lighter in fog. When waved through smoke, it leaves behind a clear path that curls closed again moments later.

6064633867292115446.title: Coralblade Wand
6064633867292115446.description: Shaped by coral-born currents and pearlescent echoes, the wand whispers lullabies of submerged gardens and tides.

6064633867294409215.title: Seabright Wand
6064633867294409215.description: Its surface shines like sunlight on shallow water. A trace of salt rides every motion.

6064633867296244230.title: Deepweld Wand
6064633867296244230.description: Heavy and steady, it bears the weight of stonebound craft. Veins of shadow seem to run through its heart.

6064633895616512013.title: Mount Cosmetic: Risen Guardian
6064633895616512013.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Sculpted from enchanted stone and awakened by ancient rites, the Risen Guardian bears its rider with solemn endurance. Its massive frame carries the weight of lost empires and buried oaths, stepping forward only when duty calls. Though silent and still at rest, it becomes an unstoppable force when set into motion.

6064633895622934547.title: Mount Cosmetic: Stallion Prime
6064633895622934547.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Bred in the royal stables of a fallen kingdom, the Stallion Prime is the very image of a noble steed. Its bearing is proud, its pace precise, and its gaze unwavering. Chosen by monarchs and warlords alike, it is a mount that embodies discipline and dignity.

6064633895656095770.title: Cosmetic: Seahawk
6064633895656095770.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895661666335.title: Cosmetic: Fellbeak Macaw
6064633895661666335.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895674773542.title: Mount Cosmetic: Sky's Vengeance
6064633895674773542.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: Born in the heart of thunderheads, Sky?s Vengeance is a tempest given wings. With stormlight crackling across its hide and clouds swirling in its wake, this flying mount cuts through the heavens like a living bolt. Only the bold dare to ride the sky?s fury.

6064633895681720364.title: Cosmetic: Watcher of the Woods
6064633895681720364.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895715930176.title: Mount Cosmetic: Eldercrown Caribou
6064633895715930176.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: With sweeping antlers shaped by time and nature, the Eldercrown Caribou moves through the frozen wilds like a spirit of the land. These majestic creatures were once considered sacred by nomadic peoples, who believed they carried the wisdom of the old world in their silent gaze. Though they can be wary of strangers, those who earn their trust find in them a steadfast companion capable of navigating even the harshest snows. Calm in demeanor yet commanding in presence, the Eldercrown is both mount and monument to Verra?s untamed north.

6064633895740833871.title: Mount Cosmetic: Drake of the Canopy
6064633895740833871.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: Sleek, silent, and terrifyingly patient, the Drake of the Canopy is a master of ambush. Cloaked in foliage-toned scales that blend effortlessly into the forest canopy, it waits motionless above the jungle floor, watching and listening for the perfect moment to strike. Its wings, veined like leaves and broad as treetops, make it nearly invisible against the dappled light of Verra?s dense woodlands. Despite its size, the drake rarely reveals itself until it is too late for its prey. Taming one is no small feat, but those who manage to bond with these elusive hunters find themselves astride one of the most cunning and visually striking mounts in all the land.

6064633895754465362.title: Cosmetic: Puirgel
6064633895754465362.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895770325086.title: Cosmetic: Shaded Duckling
6064633895770325086.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895777140834.title: Cosmetic: Sootshell
6064633895777140834.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895792803943.title: Mount Cosmetic: Saltspine
6064633895792803943.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Clad in barnacles and crusted salt, the Saltspine surges across shorelines with tidal force. Its spiked carapace wards off predators, while its bulk clears obstacles with ease. Once feared by sailors as a sea monster, it is now prized as a dependable mount for traversing wet and wild terrain.

more: Favored by the fabled Order of Giantslayers, the Duskthunder Rhino is a walking battering ram. With skin as dark as volcanic glass and eyes that burn like embers, it is built for siege and survival alike. Its heavyset frame grants incredible momentum and an almost unshakable center of gravity, allowing it to crash through enemy lines without hesitation. Riders often outfit them with Banded Giantslayer Mount Armor, transforming an already fearsome beast into a fortress on legs. Its thunderous gait is often heard long before its imposing silhouette crests the horizon.

6064634489929334793.title: Stillwake
6064634489929334793.description: This weapon does not gleam. It shivers. A hollow ring echoes from its edge with each movement, not sound but absence; the tolling of something unlived. Where the haft meets the blade, a whirling sigil spirals inward, forever collapsing into a void too quiet to defy. To carry it is to carry the memory of resistance undone.

6064634618867220530.title: Armorsmith's Skivvies
6064634618867220530.description: These scorched trousers feel born of forge and fire, with heat-hardened panels at every strain point. They carry the sweat of invention and the promise of resilience.

6064634618873118773.title: Leatherworker's Shirt
6064634618873118773.description: This stiff, thick-woven shirt bears the scent of smoke, salt, and the slow-burning acid of the tannery vat. Its sleeves are rolled high not for style, but to keep fresh-cut leather from soaking through.

6064634618899988545.title: Herbalist's Shirt
6064634618899988545.description: The pockets are too shallow, the fabric too thin--but somehow, as it takes pride in every new grass stain, it simply works.

6064634618913816644.title: Hunter's Leggings
6064634618913816644.description: Woven from wind-swept flax and padded with down, these undergarments barely rustle, even in motion. The forest will forget you're there--until it's too late.

6064634618918731846.title: Cook's Skivvies
6064634618918731846.description: Soft but never spill-shy, these kitchen-bound pants are splashed with sauce and pride. Their pockets are deep enough to hide spices, or secrets.

6064634618951893079.title: Alchemist's Shirt
6064634618951893079.description: A crisp, durable garment that breathes with every incantation. Reinforced sleeves and hidden loops cradle volatile concoctions as you stir the unknown.

6064634619330756711.title: Herbalism Sickle
6064634619330756711.description: Far from ideal for the task at hand, but trusted by village herbalists for generations.

6064634654087643242.title: Lost Bracers
6064634654087643242.description: Brace yourself for the world you will embark upon...

6064634654088298626.title: Wandering Star Treads
6064634654088298626.description: Dust of travels cling to the your soles.

6064634654088298632.title: Wandering Star Cape
6064634654088298632.description: A cape that flows like the winds of the worlds, that sparkle like the stars of the skies.

6064634654088298639.title: Lost Longbow
6064634654088298639.description: A lost weapon, but not nearly as lost as you.

6064634654088364183.title: Wanderer's Shortbow
6064634654088364183.description: Where ever you may wander, may this weapon guide you true.

6064634693120229376.title: Mount Cosmetic: Seat of Aelindor
6064634693120229376.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.

6064634693169119236.title: Mount Cosmetic: Autumn Guarden
6064634693169119236.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: A towering tangle of vine and muscle, the Guarden was first grown by ancient feykin to guard sacred groves. Now repurposed as a living mount, it carries its rider with deliberate steps and quiet strength. Beneath the petals and moss lies a beast of staggering power, moving only to protect what must never be defiled.

6064634693205688326.title: Cosmetic: Thornspire Webwarden
6064634693205688326.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.

6064634722168995844.title: Cosmetic: Thornbound Splitter
6064634722168995844.description: Applies a cosmetic appearance to your equipped Two-Handed Axe.
more: To cut from root to stem...

6064634738713690119.title: The charred, broken remains of Soonu's first fishing pole. The Ramkin used it as a fire poker before snapping it, leaving only the worn grip recognizable.

6064634761956556820.title: Mooncleaver
6064634761956556820.description: A tomb warden's sliver of night, shaped for tight halls and oath duels. Though its line was shattered by the collapse of its tomb, it rises at dusk, to deal justice.

6064634761963634715.title: Tainted Grips
6064634761963634715.description: Taken from a shrine turned slaughter ground, these grips keep the last reflex of the desperate. Ward scratches and half prayers cling to the seams, lending quick hands edged with bitter memory, hard won.

6064634762105782354.title: Cisternshade Mantle
6064634762105782354.description: A light back piece that drank the bridge?s damp silence for years, carrying the smell of underground distance. It cloaks the wearer in quiet resolve, like a traveler who knows the safest route is the one no one sees.

6064634767640559726.title: Kilnskin Wrap
6064634767640559726.description:
Drop: Jormul Warmantle 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: Charcoal-woven backcloth, firehardened in the same forge that once housed the mantle?s first bearer.

6064634767642132598.title: Raptor's Driftscale
more: A molted scale, worn smooth by dust ambushes. Bears a scratch pattern studied by raptor hunters.
